items.title: Brand-new Settings menu
items.description: Your photo and name on top, with every setting in one tidy list. On phones, tap a row to open it and use the arrow to come back.

items.title: Tap your photo to change it
items.description: No more extra card. Just tap your profile picture to pick and crop a new one.

items.title: Auto-save in Basic details
items.description: Start editing one field and open another, and the first one saves itself. In Address, press Enter to save and Shift + Enter for a new line.

items.title: Separate password and PIN pages
items.description: Change password and Change Aurafin pincode now have their own pages, easy to find.

items.title: Your name, everywhere
items.description: The name you save in Basic details now shows at the top right and in the sidebar.

items.title: Smoother taps
items.description: Menu rows now react when you press them and slide in as you move between pages.

items.title: Smoother notification swipe
items.description: Swipe a notification left or right and it follows your finger, fades slowly and slides away, like Android notifications. A small swipe just springs back.

items.title: Fewer stock alerts
items.description: Your holdings now alert only when they move 4% or 5% up or down in a day, instead of at 2%.

items.title: Correct prices without refreshing
items.description: A wrong live price no longer sticks until you refresh. Total returns now fix themselves on their own.

items.title: Net worth chart waits for live prices
items.description: The chart's latest value no longer shows a wrong number while prices are still loading.
